 All Highlights Fours Sixes Wicket UDRS 33.4 W Mahli Beardman to Jofra Archer, out Caught by Jack Edwards!! How fittingly, it's Mahli Beardman who gets the final wicket and finishes with the best bowling figures by an Australian on ODI debut . The 21-year-old finishes with stunning figures of 6/24 in 7.4 overs , as England are rolled over for just 131. He leads the Australian team off the field, with the entire stadium rising to its feet as he holds up the match ball and soaks in the applause. Archer goes hard at this wide delivery but gets it off the outer half, sending it towards backward point, where Edwards dives to his left and takes a sharp catch with both hands. That travelled quickly, and Edwards does exceptionally well to hold on to his third catch of the innings. Jofra Archer c Jack Edwards b Mahli Beardman 11(16) [4s-2] 33.3 Mahli Beardman to Jofra Archer, no run, beaten! Archer pokes at it again and is beaten as this shortish delivery skids through off the surface 33.2 Mahli Beardman to Jofra Archer, no run, typical response from the young seamer, who goes short as Archer swings and misses 33.1 4 Mahli Beardman to Jofra Archer, FOUR , Jofra Archer joins the party! Shows the full face of the bat and drives it firmly down the ground for a boundary 31.6 Mahli Beardman to Jofra Archer, 1 run, gets a thick outside edge while defending, and the ball rolls down to deep backward point for a single 31.5 Mahli Beardman to Jofra Archer, no run, defends this length delivery with soft hands to the point region 31.4 Mahli Beardman to Jofra Archer, no run, 138.3kph, beaten! Drops this one fullish around off, and Archer pokes at it but is beaten fair and square 31.4 Mahli Beardman to Jofra Archer, wide , 139.1kph, short, bends his back and bangs it into the middle of the pitch, but it goes down leg. Archer looks to pull and misses 31.3 Mahli Beardman to Jofra Archer, no run, on length angling in, Jofra Archer defends 31.2 Mahli Beardman to Jofra Archer, no run, doesn't carry to short mid-off as Renshaw does well trying to reach. Full with a hint of extra bounce, which is why Archer mistimes the drive and almost chips it to the fielder, who runs forward but fails to reach it 31.1 Mahli Beardman to Jofra Archer, no run, short of a good length, Jofra Archer gets behind the line and offers a solid back foot block 19.6 Mahli Beardman to Will Jacks, no run, short delivery, Jacks lets it go 19.5 Mahli Beardman to Will Jacks, no run, carefully clipped to mid-on 19.4 Mahli Beardman to Will Jacks, no run, short delivery, Jacks drops his hands and lets it pass 19.3 Mahli Beardman to Will Jacks, 2 runs, clips it through mid-wicket 19.2 Mahli Beardman to Will Jacks, no run, short of length delivery on the off stump, Jacks knocks it to the on-side 19.1 Mahli Beardman to Will Jacks, no run, beaten ! Fullish and moving back in, Jacks looks to drive, plays outside the line and misses 17.6 Mahli Beardman to Will Jacks, no run, fullish and around off, Will Jacks leaves it alone, and the keeper gathers cleanly 17.5 Mahli Beardman to Jamie Overton, 3 runs, a nice and easy start for Overton, who is offered a full ball on the pads. The big man gently whips it through mid-wicket for three runs and is off the mark 17.4 W Mahli Beardman to Liam Dawson, out Caught by Jack Edwards!! A five-wicket haul on debut in 28 balls. What a dream day for him. Teammates embrace him and he raises the ball to the crowd in that Australian huddle. This was a full delivery outside off stump, Dawson leans forward to push through the off-side, but the ball flies off the outer half of the bat and goes straight to backward point where Edwards takes it overhead. Because of the bounce and pace he's generating Liam Dawson c Jack Edwards b Mahli Beardman 0(6) 17.3 Mahli Beardman to Liam Dawson, no run, appeal for LBW, no says the ump and it's tough to get LBWs here in Perth unless it's really full. Ball nipped back in from good length and hit Dawson on the inner thigh pad 17.2 Mahli Beardman to Will Jacks, 1 run, to short mid-wicket 17.1 Mahli Beardman to Will Jacks, no run, pacy short ball. Gee! 145.4kph. Jacks sways out of the line as it was outside off stump 15.6 W Mahli Beardman to Sam Curran, out Caught by Adam Zampa!! Wicket number four in 24 balls now on debut. What a game he's having. Zampa points to his teammates after taking a catch close to the rope. This is a proper setup from Mahli Beardman. Bouncer was followed by a fullish ball that beat the bat. Another full ball was dished out and now he bowls the bumper again at 143.2kph and makes Curran kind of fetch the pull. Zero control over the shot, thanks to the express pace of Mahli Beardman and the bounce of Perth. Top edge flew high and straight to fine leg. Can he get a fifer in the next over? Sam Curran c Adam Zampa b Mahli Beardman 0(7) 15.5 Mahli Beardman to Sam Curran, no run, oh great stop the left and he quickly had a shy at the stumps and fired a direct-hit. Curran was out of the crease after playing that drive, he had to rush back and almost lost balance as he hurriedly got inside the crease with his back leg 15.4 Mahli Beardman to Sam Curran, no run, full and angling away now as follow up to that bumper last ball. Curran is beaten on the drive , beaten on angle 15.3 Mahli Beardman to Sam Curran, no run, short delivery, Curran just completely sits under it 15.2 Mahli Beardman to Will Jacks, 1 run, good length delivery, Jacks looks to push hard, thick edge rolls to the left of backward point 15.2 Mahli Beardman to Will Jacks, wide , oh dear he's sprayed that down the leg-side. Inglis appeals for caught behind, bowler joins and the ump shakes his head before calling that a wide 15.1 W Mahli Beardman to Jordan Cox, out Caught by Josh Inglis!! Look him wear that smile. It's so easy out in the middle for him today. He's got three wickets in 19 balls on debut and he's already the leader of this attack. In fact he's on a hat-trick . Fullish and just outside off stump, Cox plays a nothing shot. Not forward, not fully back, not even playing a proper defence. Just hung his bat out away from the body and nicked off. Inglis gets his 4th catch Jordan Cox c Josh Inglis b Mahli Beardman 2(7) 13.6 W Mahli Beardman to Joe Root, out Caught by Josh Inglis!! Joe Root was never comfortable and he nicks off. Full and asking for the drive. Nice bit of away swing on this one and Root couldn't get the cover drive right. Thick outside edge and Inglis grabs his third catch of the day. Root hardly middled the bat today. Was troubled by bounce and now some away movement gets him. The fullest ball of the over got Root. Joe Root c Josh Inglis b Mahli Beardman 17(36) [4s-1] 13.5 Mahli Beardman to Joe Root, no run, good length delivery, Root defends 13.4 4 Mahli Beardman to Joe Root, FOUR , oh inside edge past the sticks and Root gets a streaky four - the first of the day for him. Good length delivery moving away, Root looks to defend, ball just misses the stumps and fine leg was quite square 13.3 Mahli Beardman to Joe Root, 2 runs, short delivery on the leg stump, Root pulls behind square. Man at fine leg slightly fumbles and they get back for two 13.2 Mahli Beardman to Joe Root, no run, good length delivery just outside off stump, defended 13.1 Mahli Beardman to Joe Root, no run, full and moving away outside off stump, ignored 11.6 Mahli Beardman to Joe Root, 1 run, outside off this time, Root guides it to third man 11.5 Mahli Beardman to Joe Root, 2 runs, full toss, Root picks it up from outside off stump and sends it past mid-wicket 11.4 Mahli Beardman to Joe Root, no run, 139.9kph , fullish and just outside off stump, Root covers the line and defends 11.3 Mahli Beardman to Jordan Cox, leg byes, 1 run, fullish and down the leg-side, Cox misses the glance, ball hits the pad but missing leg 11.2 W Mahli Beardman to Harry Brook, out Caught by Josh Inglis!! 141kph and he's got the England captain very early. Fist pumps and punches the air in delight as he celebrates his first ODI wicket . Good length delivery angling in and nipping away. Brook was absolutely pinned on the crease. Didn't know where to go, just hung his bat down in hope with zero feet and the thick outside edge went straight to Inglis. England in a bit of trouble now. Harry Brook c Josh Inglis b Mahli Beardman 1(4) 11.1 Mahli Beardman to Joe Root, 1 run, 144.4kph , short delivery, pulled through backward square leg 9.6 Mahli Beardman to Joe Root, no run, 140.2kph, good length delivery just outside off stump, Mahli Beardman begins with a maiden over 9.5 Mahli Beardman to Joe Root, no run, bends his knees and looks to cut late but finds backward point now 9.4 Mahli Beardman to Joe Root, no run, nicely leans forward and drives as Mahli Beardman goes fuller this time, Root picks out the man at mid-off 9.3 Mahli Beardman to Joe Root, no run, 141.6kph, short of length delivery just outside off stump, Root swivels and pulls to mid-wicket 9.2 Mahli Beardman to Joe Root, no run, goes a tad fuller, Root watchfully defends to point 9.1 Mahli Beardman to Joe Root, no run, 135.3kph on this short of length delivery from the debutant, Root stands tall and defends LATEST NEWS
